item.title: [Hot] New entry (#3): connector-spotify
item.description: New entry in Hot leaderboard. Rank: #3 Installs: 9 Source: caffeinelabs/skills Description: MANDATORY recipe for every Caffeine build that reads Spotify catalog data or drives a user's Spotify account from a canister.
